# setting_type { #crossrepo.config.setting_type }

```python
crossrepo.config.setting_type(key)
```

What kind of value a setting takes.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**key**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Name of a setting.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[type](`type`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   `list` for a setting holding several strings, `int` for a count of bytes, `str` for anything else.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[KeyError](`KeyError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If there is no such setting. The caller says what the names are, since it is the caller that knows how they were asked for.
